senses.en: to rest with your bottom on a chair or other surface
to be in a particular place or position

example.en: The old castle sits on a hill.

senses.en: to have a meeting or be in session

example.en: The court will sit next Monday.

senses.en: to take an exam or test

example.en: She sat the final exam yesterday.
example.zh: 她昨天参加了期末考试。

senses.en: the feeling you get when you are afraid or worried that something bad may happen

example.en: Her fear of the dark kept her awake.
example.zh: 她对黑暗的恐惧让她睡不着。

senses.en: to feel afraid of someone or something, or to worry that something bad will happen

example.en: Many people fear losing their jobs.

senses.en: inside a place, thing, or area

example.en: She left her keys in the car.

senses.en: during a particular period of time
using a particular language, material, or form
senses.zh: 用；以（某种语言、材料或形式）

example.en: Please write your answer in English.
